newsitem.title: UK: BOC SHARES TURN LOWER ON PROFIT-TAKING.
newsitem.headline: BOC SHARES TURN LOWER ON PROFIT-TAKING.

text.p: Shares in specialist gases company BOC Group Plc turned lower in late trading as profit-taking eroded gains posted immediately after the release of nine-month results.
BOC was down 11 pence at 11.59 pounds by 1546 GMT. The shares have been in a clear uptrend since April 17, when they closed at 9.02-1/2 stg.
Analysts said BOC results were broadly in line with expectations.
"It is a fairly steady company and there were no surprises in the results," said David Ingles at HSBC James Capel.
Pre-tax profit for the nine months to June 30 came in at 325.4 million stg compared with 327.3 million a year ago.
Ingles said he marginally raised his full year pre-tax profit forecast to 438 million stg from 435 million.
He said some other analysts had initially pencilled in 445 million stg. But these bulls might revise their estimates slightly downwards after the nine-month results, Ingles added.
